hypothesis: Adding a generic level-coordinate marginal CRPS term in standardized level-delta space to the 755a short-prefix AR flow should improve median/level allocation without post-hoc calibration.

implementation.base_recipe: 755a short-prefix generated FM K=5 with channel-level energy

comparison_to_755a.validation_changes: cointegration becomes passable by worst-cell ratio, but coverage, level-KS, median-bias, and mean-reversion degrade.
comparison_to_755a.train_tail_changes: in-sample level marginal metrics remain decent but cointegration, time-series kurtosis, risk-state allocation, and coverage degrade versus 755a.

decision: Reject this level-marginal-CRPS variant as a promotion candidate. The failure mechanism is not lack of any level proper score; the new score creates a central-level/structural-dynamics trade-off and does not replace 755a.
